title: Optimally Optimized MC
description: Optimally Optimized is a lightweight Minecraft modpack built to maximize your FPS and eliminate game lag. It delivers a butter-smooth, pure vanilla experience that makes the game run flawlessly on any PC.
body:
**Optimally Optimized MC** is a lightweight Fabric performance pack built on 1.19.2 and other versions coming in updates to maximize your FPS and eliminate game lag. It combines essential engine fixes like Sodium, Iris Shaders, and Lithium with smart memory optimizations to guarantee a butter-smooth, pure vanilla experience on any hardware.

Features

* Maximum FPS: Smooth rendering powered by Sodium, Indium, and Iris.
* Stutter Fixes: MemoryLeakFix, FerriteCore, and ModernFix stop random lag spikes.
* Vanilla Plus: Zoomify, ModMenu, and full customization menus built right in.
* LAN Connection Utilities: mods like e4all and LAN server properties allow you to host your friends right off the bat.
* Cosmetic Skin Restorers: Custom Skin Loader, 3d skin layers  and skin restorer allow you to use a preferred minecraft skin or make sure you don't look like a default Steve or Alex when you join a server and keeping your custom skin cool looking with a 3d skin renderer inbuilt in 3d skin layers.
* Patch notes: version 1.0 - 1.2 and 1.4 are now unstable due to mod incompatibility, upgrade to 1.3 or 1.5 for a seamless experience, 1.6 coming soon.
